recommendations: Miguel Tormo “I had the pleasure of mentoring Shravan during his summer internship at Amazon Search. He took on a challenging project that involved implementing a new feature in a large scale distributed system, and successfully delivered it despite the complexity of our internal systems. He demonstrated a strong ability to grasp complex concepts and determination to overcome any challenges along the way. Shravan was great to work with: he communicates clearly and treats feedback as an opportunity to grow. Over the course of the internship, I saw clear progress in both coding quality and problem solving skills. He also prepared and delivered an excellent presentation to the team at the end of his internship. I would gladly work with him again and recommend him without hesitation.”

volunteer_experience.info: Over the course of the summer, I volunteered in teaching a number of classes for middle and high school student. The classes I co-instructed include: - Introduction to Computer Science - Introduction to Front-End Development - Introduction to Marine Science - Introduction to 3D Modeling Through this volunteering opportunity, I was also awarded the Gold Presidential Volunteer Service Award.

projects.title: Effectiveness of different concentrations of T4/T4r Bacteriophages in killing E.coli
projects.description: Conducted a scientific research project titled "Effectiveness of Different Concentrations of T4/T4r Bacteriophages in Killing E. coli." This involved the full biological research process, including inoculating petri dishes, cultivating bacteria, testing various bacteriophage concentrations, and analyzing data to measure cell death and effectiveness of different treatments.

honors_and_awards.title: USABO Semifinals Qualifier
honors_and_awards.description: The USA Biology Olympiad, or USABO, is a prestigious biology competition for high school students in the United States. Launched in 2002, USABO's mission is to recognize and empower up-and-coming life science students through rigorous biology exams and international networking opportunities. This year, with a score of 28, I qualified for the Semifinals round of the USABO, placing me amongst the top 10% of national test-takers.

honors_and_awards.description: The TechRise Challenge is a nationwide contest designed to engage students in grades 6-12 in technology, science, and space exploration.
